name: HMS Ark Royal (R09), Audacious class, after the 1967-70 refit

published.source: en.wikipedia 'HMS Ark Royal (R09)' / 'Audacious-class aircraft carrier': 804 ft (245 m) overall, 171 ft (52 m) over the angled deck, hull beam 112.8 ft (34.4 m), draught 33 ft (10 m)

references.name: [AT] Ark Royal from overhead, NAN 1-71 (plan, photograph)
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Ark Royal R09 from top lauch Buc NAN1-71.jpg' (US Navy, Naval Aviation News 1-71), 1600 x 985
references.note: Taken from high above, bow left, starboard (the island) up: turned 180 deg to put the bow right and port up, and 1.5 deg more for the ship's axis (bridle-catcher tip px (95, 618), stern deck end centre (1402, 652)). Scale 5.35 px/m: the 1307 px from the bow bridle-catcher tip to the stern deck end taken as 244.5 m of the published 245 m overall. The island and the starboard side are lost in spray and the replenishment ship alongside, the sea is dark like the deck: the mask is NOT usable for an outline (reported only); measured by hand instead (landmarks).

references.name: [AR] Ark Royal from the starboard bow, North Atlantic, July 1976 (photograph)
references.source: Wikimedia Commons '17 HMS Ark Royal North Atlantic July 76.jpg', 1600 x 1146
references.note: Starboard bow, low: for the reviewer. Heights scaled off the Phantom FG.1 parked forward (published 5.0 m over 47 px, 9.4 px/m at the bow): flight deck 18.6 m over the water at the bow. Shows, aft to fore: the after lattice mast with its radar on the island's after end, the dome abaft the island, the pole mainmast with its yard, the forward lattice mast with the large double bedstead (AKE-2), the stepped island with its window rows and funnel, the deck-edge galleries, the boat and sponson openings in the hull side, the bow bridle catcher.

must_show: angled flight deck: the port sponson standing out to y +26 abreast the island, x -50..+30 (d 90-170), the landing centreline 8.9 deg to port from x +47 (d 75.7) aft

the square-fronted bow: the flight deck ends in a straight front edge at x +110.5 (d 12), about +-13.7 m, and only the bow bridle-catcher boom (3 m wide at its root, tapering) runs on to x +122 (d 0.5) [AT][AR]
the island on its starboard sponson, x -39.5..+30.5 (d 92-162), outboard to y -26.2, three stepped blocks to z 31.5
the funnel on the island, x +1..+2.5 (d 120-121.5), top z 35
the forward lattice mast x +5.5..+10.5 (d 112-117) with the double AKE-2 bedstead on its platform, top z 45.8
the pole mainmast at x -2.5 (d 125) to z 53.5 with its yard at z 47.5
the after lattice mast x -29.5..-24.5 (d 147-152) with the AKE-1 bedstead on its platform, top z 42.7
the waist bridle catcher on the port sponson at x 60.5 (d 62), y +23.8
the deck-edge galleries round the whole flight deck, z 15.2..16.8
boats in davits, three a side, x 40.5..62.5 (d 60-82) at z 12

the port sponson's half breadth: [AT] reads about +22 m abreast the island, but the published 52 m over the angled deck with the island at -26.2 needs +25.8; the model keeps +26 (published). For the lead / reviewer

the bow front's breadth: [AT] shows about 20 m across (about +5.5 / -14.6 m from the bridle-catcher boom's line, which may stand off the centreline); the model takes +-13.7 m, the hull's forecastle breadth under it, so no hull stands outside the deck
